- 3D grid `(B, C_out, ceil(spatial/256))` maps naturally to batch, channel, and spatial dimensions
- Fused all operations into one kernel to avoid the intermediate 439M-element tensor round-trip
- GELU via tanh approximation since `al.erf` accuracy is warned against on gfx942 BF16
